data.rationale: The proposal matches the true steps in order (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number) and adds the suggestion-select and submit steps that the generic steps also list. It adds a route_suggestion parameter that is vague, but it is probably derivable from the service number, so an automation could still be built.
